name: Potion of Healing (Supreme)

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

summary: Bonus Action to drink or give to a creature within 5 ft: regain 10d4 + 20 Hit Points.
text: A magic item. As a Bonus Action, you drink it or give it to a creature within 5 feet of you. Whoever drinks the red liquid regains 10d4 + 20 Hit Points.
